# CodePipelineReviewRecheckPolicy

Which reviewers on a review panel review again after a fix round, decided from what each found in the round before.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in requests and responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"AllMembers"` | Every reviewer. The default. |
| `"OnePerFlaggingLens"` | For each lens where any reviewer found problems, the lens's first reviewer in panel order; plus every reviewer with `alwaysRecheck`. |
| `"FlaggingMembers"` | Only the reviewers that found problems, plus every reviewer with `alwaysRecheck`. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`CodePipelineReviewPanel`](code-pipeline-review-panel.md)
